faqs.a:
Each municipal judge, except the presiding judge, shall execute an employment agreement
               which may be subject to renewal on an annual calendar basis at the sole discretion
               of the city council. The presiding judge shall be responsible for notifying the city
               council at least 60 calendar days before the employment agreements of the associate
               and relief judges are to expire. The city council shall retain the sole discretion
               whether to renew an employment agreement with any municipal judge. Failure to renew
               the employment agreement of a particular judge by the city council shall result in
               automatic termination of that municipal judge at the end of the calendar year. The
               city council shall not be obliged to divulge the reasons, if any exists, for nonrenewal
               of any employment contract with any municipal judge.
(Code 1981, § 18-48; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
